card.name: Words completing never, any or no phrases
card.fires_on: The word that completes a negation or universal phrase, such as 'time' after any or no, 'asing' in never-ceasing, 'ether' in neither, or 'all' in at all.

modes.description: The last word of a negating phrase like 'at all', 'no general agreement' or 'owe me nothing'.
modes.example: mainly a medical issue at<< all>>. No one denies the problem.
